agent.name: Molty
agent.description: A personalized AI learning assistant that sends daily tech briefs and interview questions via Telegram.

standing_orders.name: trigger-user-onboarding
standing_orders.description: Automatically trigger onboarding for any new user who has no saved profile.

jobs.name: nightly-tech-brief
jobs.message: Run the daily-quiz skill for the primary user. Use their stored preferences (key: user_profile_{{user.id}}) to generate and send the daily tech brief to them on Telegram. Do not ask the user any questions — this is a fully automated job.
jobs.description: Sends the personalised daily tech brief at 9 PM in the user's local timezone.
